decisive_items: She was receiving milrinone at home through a double lumen tunneled catheter.
Initial blood culture from tunneled catheter: positive at 7.2 hours
Gram stain from all three sets showed gram-negative bacilli
missing_items: Peripheral blood culture positive earlier than catheter culture (5.13h vs 7.2h) argues against catheter as source
No local signs of catheter site infection (no erythema, warmth, discharge)

rejected.why: Sepsis is a clinical syndrome but lacks the specificity of identifying the catheter as the source and the gram-negative organism.
